text:
[Council File 14-1697-S4]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (YAROSLAVSKY - PADILLA) relative to reactivating and restoring C.F. 14-1697-S4 to its most recent legislative status as of the date of the File’s expiration.
Recommendation for Council action:
REACTIVATE and RESTORE the matter relative to instructing the Los Angeles Department of Building and Safety to provide an update to the 2018 progress report titled, Update on the Progress of the Mandatory Soft-Story and Non-Ductile Concrete Retrofit Programs, (Council File No.14-1697-S4), which expired per Council policy (Council File No. 05-0553), be reactivated and that the matter be restored to its most recent legislative status as of the date of the File's expiration.
summary: Reactivates an expired Council file so the Building and Safety Department must update its 2018 report on the mandatory soft-story and non-ductile concrete retrofit programs.

outcome.text: Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Oct 20, 2026); Council action final
